reviews.name: Razeena Bhol
reviews.text: This is a very cute Café. Love the atmosphere. Food is tasty. Overall a good experience. It was very busy the day we had gone and food had been delayed quite a bit. The good service however makes up for delays and look forward to going back. Parking however is an issue and maybe a plan can be made for customers?

reviews.name: Bronwen de Klerk
reviews.text: Great food and the most delicious  cheese cake selection. Coffee is amazing.  Very friendly  service. And you can request  a tune of ur choice  from the amazing  collection  of records or Cd's. They have recently  opened  another branch  in Plumstead  and we are definitely  going soon. 👌

reviews.name: Tanealé Kruger
reviews.text: Amazing time, staff tonight was excellent, definitely recommend!! Hands down the best burgers we've had in Cape Town so far!! Will definitely be back again.

reviews.name: Raushan Essop
reviews.text:
What an amazing restaurant. I loved the vibe. The food was great. I had the nacho burger and my wife had the one with the pineapple on, I forgot the name but it was so filling and delicious.
We also had brownie cake which was 10/10 for us.
Everyone's different but that was my opinion.
